pairs.selection: Competitor fixed from first existing P24 development episode before any O24 outcome; B2 uses nearest legal coarse cell, not nonexistent true cell
pairs.margin_definition: log posterior probability at fixed near-source cell minus log probability at fixed competitor, at each full source update. No epsilon floor; zero reported as -inf/undefined when bothzero.
